name: Deborah Smith

conflicts.siteValue: One 'Deborah Smith' as wife of both Joshua Smith II (H0279) and William Lawrence Jr. (H0488), mother of both Joshua B. Smith and Adam Lawrence
conflicts.foundValue: Two different women: (a) Deborah, daughter of Bull Smith, who married William Lawrence Jr. in 1680 and was mother of Adam Lawrence; (b) Deborah, daughter of Epenetus Smith 1st, third wife of Judge Joshua Smith II (1763-1845)
conflicts.assessment: Split into two records. Note also that Pelletreau names Joshua II's wives as Mary Blydenburgh, Ruth Smith and Deborah (Epenetus); whether Deborah was Joshua B. Smith's mother should be checked (Joshua B. b. 1801).

sources.citation: Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), p. 34
sources.supports: William Lawrence Jr. m. 1680 Deborah dau. of Richard Smith, patentee

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 477
sources.supports: Joshua Smith 2d m. (1) Mary Blydenburgh (2) Ruth Smith (3) Deborah dau. of Epenetus Smith 1st

researchLogEntry: Round 4: record conflates two Deborah Smiths (Bull Smith's daughter, wife of William Lawrence Jr.; and Epenetus's daughter, wife of Joshua Smith II).
